g.text: P = shoots first. S = shoots second (waits for the tip).

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Each alliance: P parks in the INNER slot (zone end toward

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: midfield), S in the OUTER slot (zone end toward its wall).

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Red P starts at the audience wall; blue P at the scoring wall.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Auto-SWARM: 16 points by end of AUTO

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Each robot: LEAVE 3 + AUTO PARK 5. Both robots = 16 =

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: SWARM RP at events using the default threshold (Table 10-3).

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Judged at the END of AUTO: a robot touching the perimeter

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: wall then gets no LEAVE. PARK = partly in the loading zone.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Our slots stop 5.6 in off the wall and 5.4 in into the tape.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Touch a wall, own half, not in the loading zone, not

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: touching a flower, exactly 4 pollen preloaded.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: P: square to wall; midline-side edge 3.7 in from center seam.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: S: square to wall; 1.0 in gap to flower AND to center seam.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Spacer gauges are allowed (G302); remove before the match (G303).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Our S feeds from t=15 s: partner P must finish shooting by

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: ~14 s and clear its lane. S delay is an INIT row if needed.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: Park-only partner: take the opposite lane and slot; end

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: partly in the zone and OFF the wall. From mid audience

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: wall, do not drive the straight diagonal: it hits the frame.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Drawn from FTC field CAD v26-27.2 with an 18 in robot.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Times are planned, not measured. Verify on a real field.
